candidate.title: Embed controller spec for missing embed_url is a false positive due to embeddable_host default failure
reports: spec/controllers/embedcontrollerspec.rb:8 'is 404 without an embedurl' passes because the default empty embeddablehost makes ensureembeddable raise before params.require runs, leaving missing-param behavior untested
candidate.example: spec/controllers/embedcontrollerspec.rb:8 'is 404 without an embedurl' passes because the default empty embeddablehost makes ensureembeddable raise before params.require runs, leaving missing-param be

fix_scope: minimal fix for the demonstrated instance only

sibling_instances.note: other instances of this class are unverified siblings

notes: The claim is about the SPEC, not the product: the example named "is 404 without an embed_url" asserts only response.should_not be_success and stubs no host.

PATH A (spec config, embeddable_host unset): the before_filter ensure_embeddable raises Discourse::InvalidAccess("embeddable host not set") — so the example passes on the 403 filter path and never reaches the missing-param code it claims to test.
PATH B (host configured, no embed_url): params.require(:embed_url) raises ActionController::ParameterMissing => HTTP 400 — so the example name's "404" is also wrong.

FIDELITY DISCLOSURE: the REAL EmbedController#best and #ensure_embeddable are executed; actionpack 4.1 cannot load standalone here, so ActionController::Parameters/ParameterMissing and String#blank?/NilClass#blank? are shape-stubs with identical semantics (visible at the top of the test).
NOT A PRODUCT BUG: the endpoint behaves reasonably (403 without a configured host; 400 for a missing required param). The defect is a vacuous spec, which hides regressions in the path it names.
recommended_action: improve the spec: stub SiteSetting.embeddable_host + a matching referer, then assert the real status for the missing-embed_url case (400), or rename the example
